main_text.l: animum firmant. fraudes, ac technæ in com-
miniscendis rebus similibus Photij, cui notæ
non sunt? Et ante omnia illud consideran-
dum est, postremam hanc Photianam, null-
a cogente necessitate, celebratam fuisse.
Nanque antea Basilio intercedente, & Io-
anne Pontifice non renuente Photius, mul-
tis Ioannem laudibus extollens, nullam de
Symboli additione fecit mentionē; Ecclesiæ
Romanæ reconciliatus, & tantundem con-
cupita a se Sede recuperata, frustra denuo in
Ioannem, & reliquos Romanos, quorum
alienatione tot sibi miserrime viventi mala
evenere, & ut eos sibi benevolos redderet,
tot labores animo semper perturbato, atque
incerto insumpserat, eiectus, profugus, tri-
stis, inops, tum postmodum illorum sibi re-
conciliatorum, nulla id exposcente neces-
sitate, animos denuo exasperasset. Frustra
cum quiescimus, turbas quærimus, & cum
pace fruimur, hostes ad iracundiam, & po-
tissimum si sunt melioris conditionis, con-
citamus. Id plane fuisset irritare crabrones.
Annon una solutus plaga, stolide novis co-
natibus obductam sibi ab Ecclesia Roma-
na cicatricem refricasset, ut novum vulnus
exciperet? Non sunt contemnenda, quæ

page.notes: Page is printed in one column with no marginal text. Ink stains and show-through on the left and right edges are not transcribed. Several words are read with some doubt because of the scan: "mentionē" (macron over e), "viventi", "exposcente". The printed long s has been written as plain s throughout, and the printed spelling "fibi"/"fruftra" has been normalised to sibi/frustra per the long-s rule. Printed u/v spellings ("viuenti", "euenere", "Annon vna", "nouis") have been changed to v/u per the rule. Catchword "Ec-" at the foot right. No running head or signature printed.
